rationale: The original entry premise of weak buying pressure below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($39.10) failed immediately upon entry as a 30.7k-share volume spike drove price to $39.38. Subsequent 1-minute bars formed a constructive low-volume pullback holding $39.16—well above the 9-EMA—followed by renewed buying volume (13.6k shares) pushing price back to $39.30, shifting short-term momentum against the position ahead of VWAP.
